cutoff.meaning: The meeting ends at 4:00 PM Eastern Time on 12 March 2026; any votes not cast by then do not count.

negative_condition: The committee does not approve the request if fewer than two members vote in favor, or if the required votes are not cast before the meeting ends.
positive_condition: The committee approves the request if at least two of the three voting members vote in favor.

proof.meaning: The official minutes of the 12 March 2026 meeting recording the votes of each member.
proof.name: meeting minutes
proof.subject: committee members

terminal_meaning: The committee's recorded votes under its own majority rule determine whether the compassionate-use request is approved or not.
